about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Op. Dr. Fahri Temiz
about.intro: Op. Dr. Fahri Temiz is an experienced physician specialized in obstetrics and gynecology in Izmir Buca, with over 15 years of experience. He provides reliable and personalized healthcare services to patients from Buca and surrounding districts using all the possibilities of modern medicine.
about.experience: As one of Izmir's most experienced obstetricians and gynecologists, he offers services in a wide range from pregnancy follow-up to gynecological surgery, from urogynecology to aesthetic gynecology. Patients from Buca, Konak, Karabaglar, Gaziemir, and Bornova prefer our clinic.
about.philosophy: Our philosophy is to recognize that each woman's health needs are unique and to shape treatment accordingly.
